title: NVIDIA Q4 Fiscal 2026 Earnings Call
summary: NVIDIA reported record Q4 revenue of $68.1 billion, up 73% YoY. CEO Jensen Huang highlighted the massive ramp of Blackwell GPUs and the emergence of 'Agentic AI' as a primary driver. Data Center revenue hit $62.3 billion, driven by hyperscalers and sovereign AI cloud initiatives. Guidance for Q1 FY27 was set at $72.0 billion.

title: NVIDIA Q3 Fiscal 2026 Earnings Call
summary: Q3 revenue reached $57.0 billion. Sentiment was dominated by the early delivery of Blackwell systems and strong demand for H200 networking solutions. Management addressed supply chain efficiency, noting that CoWoS capacity is improving but remains a long-term constraint for meeting total global demand.

title: NVIDIA Q2 Fiscal 2026 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue hit $46.7 billion. Key focus was on 'Sovereign AI'—governments building domestic AI infrastructure. Management highlighted massive software adoption via NVIDIA AI Enterprise. China revenue remained stable but lower as a percentage of total, offset by strength in the Middle East and Europe.

title: NVIDIA Q1 Fiscal 2026 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $44.1 billion. The call focused on the transition from Hopper to Blackwell architecture. Management addressed concerns regarding a potential 'air pocket' in demand, reassuring investors that Blackwell demand is multi-generational. Industrial robotics and Omniverse segments were highlighted as future growth pillars.

title: NVIDIA Q4 Fiscal 2025 Earnings Call
summary: Annual revenue hit $130.5 billion. Jensen Huang described a 'tipping point' for Generative AI. Sentiment was exceptionally high as Data Center revenue crossed $100 billion for the first time annually. Discussion included the GB200 Superchip roadmap and liquid-cooling infrastructure requirements for new data centers.

title: NVIDIA Q3 Fiscal 2025 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $35.1 billion. Call was focused on supply chain bottlenecks. Management noted that while demand is insatiable, production is limited by advanced packaging availability. Positive sentiment around Spectrum-X networking which began contributing significant revenue as an Ethernet-based alternative for AI.

title: NVIDIA Q2 Fiscal 2025 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue hit $30.0 billion, doubling YoY. Management highlighted the shift of the world's $1 trillion data center install base to accelerated computing. Sentiment remained bullish on H100/H200 demand. Announced a 10-for-1 stock split earlier in the quarter was discussed as a move for employee/investor accessibility.

title: NVIDIA Q1 Fiscal 2025 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue reached $26.0 billion. Management introduced the concept of 'AI Factories' where data centers produce intelligence. Sentiment was high due to strong forward guidance. Discussion included the GTC 2024 Blackwell launch and the expanding ecosystem of developers using CUDA.

title: NVIDIA Q4 Fiscal 2024 Earnings Call
summary: NVIDIA shattered expectations with $22.1 billion in revenue. Data Center revenue up 409% YoY. Management pointed to a massive platform shift toward Generative AI. Sentiment was overwhelmingly positive as the 'AI Gold Rush' was reflected in the balance sheet for the first time at scale.

title: NVIDIA Q3 Fiscal 2024 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $18.1 billion. The primary sentiment hurdle was new US government export controls on China. Management noted that while China revenue would decline, growth in other regions was more than sufficient to compensate. H100 adoption remained the central narrative.

title: NVIDIA Q2 Fiscal 2024 Earnings Call
summary: The 'Mega-Beat' quarter. Revenue of $13.5 billion, far exceeding guidance. Management cited a 'new era' of computing. Sentiment was ecstatic as the stock reached new all-time highs. Cloud service providers (CSPs) were reported to be in a race to secure H100 capacity.

title: NVIDIA Q1 Fiscal 2024 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $7.19 billion. This was the 'Inflection Point' call where NVIDIA raised guidance by $4 billion for the next quarter. Sentiment shifted instantly from 'Post-Crypto Recovery' to 'AI Boom.' Jensen Huang famously said data centers are shifting to accelerated computing.

title: NVIDIA Q4 Fiscal 2023 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $6.05 billion. Sentiment was cautious but optimistic. Management addressed the surge in interest in Large Language Models (LLMs) following the launch of ChatGPT. The 'AI at an inflection point' phrase was first used here. Gaming was still recovering from inventory gluts.

title: NVIDIA Q3 Fiscal 2023 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $5.93 billion. Highly negative sentiment in the Gaming segment (down 51% YoY) due to the crypto-mining crash. Management focused on inventory write-downs and the launch of the Ada Lovelace architecture (RTX 40-series) to clear the channel.

title: NVIDIA Q2 Fiscal 2023 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue hit $6.70 billion. A challenging call where management addressed a significant miss in preliminary revenue. Sentiment was defensive as the company scrambled to manage excess GPU inventory in a post-lockdown, post-mining market.

title: NVIDIA Q1 Fiscal 2023 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $8.29 billion. Management noted strong Data Center demand but cited macro headwinds from Russia-Ukraine and China lockdowns. Sentiment was mixed as record revenue was balanced against rising global economic uncertainty.

title: NVIDIA Q4 Fiscal 2022 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $7.64 billion. Sentiment was high as Data Center became the largest segment. Discussion included the failed Arm acquisition, but management remained bullish on a software-led strategy and the expansion of the 'Omniverse' vision.

title: NVIDIA Q3 Fiscal 2022 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $7.10 billion. Management highlighted record Gaming revenue despite severe supply constraints. Sentiment was positive regarding the RTX 30-series demand and the early adoption of the NVIDIA AI Enterprise software suite.

title: NVIDIA Q2 Fiscal 2022 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $6.51 billion. Sentiment focused on the successful integration of Mellanox and its role in Data Center growth. Management discussed the 'CMP' (Crypto Mining Processor) as a way to prioritize gamers while still capturing mining revenue.

title: NVIDIA Q1 Fiscal 2022 Earnings Call
summary: Revenue of $5.66 billion. Management addressed the global chip shortage. Sentiment was positive as record growth was seen across all segments. Jensen Huang described the quarter as 'exceptional' as enterprise AI moved into mainstream verticals like healthcare and finance.
